conclusion: Under-growers cap on the TRACE nitrate pool (0.11 mM), not nucleobases. Removing nucleobases does nothing; removing nitrate abolishes growth; boosting nitrate alone gives 68x. DM38 has abundant ammonium (9.35 mM) and the GEM has ammonium-assimilation enzymes, but boosting ammonium does nothing -- the GEM has an artifactual hard dependence on nitrate and cannot grow on ammonium. Confirmed dynamically for DF; the earlier reduced-cost signal (no3_e ranking high) indicates the same for PC/BH/BA/BC but that is not yet dynamically verified. The 89x 'nucleotide rescue' in 81a6344 was an artifact: that boost list also raised no3_e, so nitrate did the work and was misattributed to the nucleobases.
